We compute three types of winning rates: WS, WR, QS ... using PandaLM and GPT-4 as judges.

We compute three types of winning rates: (1) WS, a winning score formulated as WS=1 + #win-#lose #all . (2) WR, which considers wins cases and is given by WR= #win #all , where #all is the number of test set samples; (3) QS, a quality score that measures the ratio of responses reaching the reference level, formulated as QS= #win+#tie #all .
